title: Must I Go And Empty Handed

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Not one day of service give Him,
Lay no trophy at His feet?

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Must I meet my Saviour so?
Not one soul with which to greet Him,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Not at death I shrink nor falter,
For my Saviour saves me now;
Thought of that now clouds my brow.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: O the years in sinning wasted,
Could I but recall them now;
I would give them to my Saviour,
To His will I'd gladly bow.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: O ye saints, arouse, be earnest,
Up and work while yet 'tis day;
Ere the night of death o'ertake thee,
Strive for souls while still you may.

title: To The Work

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: To the work! to the work! we are servants of God,
Let us follow the path that our Master has trod;
With the balm of His counsel our strength to renew,
Let us do with our might what our hands find to do.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Let us hope, let us watch,
And labor till the Master comes.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: To the work! to the work! let the hungry be fed,
To the fountain of life let the weary be led;
In the cross and its banner our glory shall be,
While we herald the tidings, "Salvation is free!"

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: To the work! to the work! there is labor for all,
For the kingdom of darkness and error shall fall;
And the name of Jehovah exalted shall be
In the loud swelling chorus, "Salvation is free!"

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: To the work! to the work! in the strength of the Lord,
And a robe and a crown shall our labor reward
When the home of the faithful our dwelling shall be
And we shout with the ransomed, "Salvation is free!"

title: Till The Whole World Knows

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: I will tell to all that God is love;
For the world has never known
The great compassion of His heart
For the wayward and the lone.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: I will shout and sing of Christ my King,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: I'll tell of mercy's boundless tide,
Like the waters of the sea,
That covers every sin of man;

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: I'll tell of grace that keeps the soul,
Of faith that overcomes the world,
With its tumult and its din.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: That awaits the sons of light;
For the children of the night.

title: Rescue The Perishing

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Rescue the perishing, care for the dying,
Snatch them in pity from sin and the grave;
Weep o'er the erring one, lift up the fallen,
Tell them of Jesus the mighty to save.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Though they are slighting Him, still He is waiting,
Waiting the penitent child to receive;
Plead with them earnestly, plead with them gently,
He will forgive if they only believe.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Down in the human heart, crushed by the tempter,
Feelings lie buried that grace can restore;
Touched by a loving heart, wakened by kindness,
Chords that are broken will vibrate once more.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Rescue the perishing, duty demands it,
Strength for thy labour the Lord will provide;
Back to the narrow way patiently win them,
Tell the poor wanderer a Saviour has died.

title: Win Them One By One

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: 1 If to Christ our only king
Men redeemed we strive to bring,
Just one way this may be done—
We must win them one by one.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: So you bring the one next to you,
And I’ll bring the one next to me;
In all kinds of weather, we’ll all work together,
And see what can be done;

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: If you’ll bring the one next to you,
And I bring the one next to me,
In no time at all we’ll have them all,
So win them, win them, one by one.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Side by side we stand each day,
Saved are we, but lost are they;
They will come if we but dare
Speak a word backed up by prayer.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Dare this gift of God misuse;
Ere some friend goes to his grave,
Speak a word his soul to save.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Not for hope of great reward
Turn men’s hearts unto the Lord;
Just to see a saved man smile
Makes the effort well worth while.

title: Go And Tell The Story

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Go and tell the story to thy friends to-day,
How the Lord of glory met thee on thy way;
How He cleansed thy spirit from the stain of sin,
Driving out the foe who reigned thy heart within.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Go and tell the story, tell it fer and wide,
How the Lord of glory for the sinner died;
And the soul that hears it, and in faith believes,
Straightway he the cleansing from the Lord receives.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Go and tell the story, of His pow'r to save,
Of the sinful "Legion" sunk beneath the wave;
Tell of His compassion, of His love so true,
Of the wondrous things the Lord hath done for you.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Go and tell the story, how He reigns above,
Winning men to glory thro' His dying love;
How He waits to crown them kings forevermore,
In the home awaiting, on the other shore.

title: Brighten The Corner Where You Are

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Do not wait until some deed of greatness you may do,
Do not wait to shed your light afar;
To the many duties ever near you now be true,
Brighten the corner where you are.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Brighten the corner where you are!
Brighten the corner where you are!
Someone far from harbour you may guide across the bar,
Brighten the corner where you are.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Just above are clouded skies that you may help to clear,
Let not narrow self your way debar;
Though into one heart alone may fall your song of cheer,
Brighten the corner where you are.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Here for all your talent you will surely find a need,
Here reflect the Bright and Morning star;
Even from your humble hand the bread of life may feed,
Brighten the corner where you are.

title: Lift Him Up

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: How to reach the masses, men of every birth,
For an answer Jesus gave the key:
"And I, if I be lifted up from the earth,
Will draw all men unto Me."

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: "And I, if I be lifted up from the earth,
Will draw all men unto Me."

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Oh! The world is hungry for the living bread,
Lift the Saviour up for them to see;
Trust Him, and do not doubt the words that He said,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Don't exalt the preacher, don't exalt the pew,
Preach the Gospel simple, full and free;
Prove Him and you will find that promise is true,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Lift Him up by living as a Christian ought,
Let the world in you the Saviour see;
Then men will gladly follow Him who once taught,

title: Carry Your Bible

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: It will supply you each moment,

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: O take it wherever you go.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Sweeter each day it will grow;
Somewhere some heart will be waiting,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Tell it to hearts plunged in woe;

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: God’s path from sin unto safety,

title: Show A Little Bit Of Love And Kindness

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Sing a song, spread some cheer,
There are sad and lonely people ev'rywhere;
Be a friend, show some love,
It will lift them from the dungeons of despair.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Show a little bit of love and kindness,
Never go along with hatred's blindness,
Take a little time to reach for joy and wear a happy face;
Sing a little bit when the days are dreary,
Give a little help to a friend who's weary
That's the way to make the world a happy place.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: To the fainting and discouraged on life's road;
See a need, lend a hand,
There are many who are crushed beneath their load.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Be a light, show the way,
Be a light within the night for those astray;
That will bring them back to walk the narrow way.

title: I Love To Tell The Story

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: I love to tell the story
I love to tell the story

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: I love to tell the story!
to tell the old, old story

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: I love to tell the story;
I love to tell the story,
it did so much for me;
and that is just the reason
I tell it now to thee.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: I love to tell the story;
what seems, each time I tell it,
I love to tell the story,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: I love to tell the story,
for those who know it best
to hear it like the rest.
And when in scenes of glory
I sing the new, new song,
that I have loved so long.

title: Do Something For Others

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Many a soul in the battle of life
Trembles with fear at the din and the strife,
Bearing alone, amid trial and care,
Burdens and sorrows God bids you to share.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Many in doubt or in fear of the way,
Mutely appeal for your guidance today;
On your demeanor the choice may depend—
Are you concerned for the stranger or friend?

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Broken and worn by the pangs of defeat,
Waiting, perhaps, for your strengthening hand.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Many are turning away from the right
Into the maze of the shadows of night;
Go to them, speak to them, over them pray,
Help them, support them—do something today. [Refrain]

title: Speak A Word For Jesus

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Speak just a word for Jesus,
Tell how he died for you;

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Tell what He's doing for you!

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Speak just a word for Jesus,
Tell how He helps you live;
Tell of the strength and comfort

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Speak just a word for Jesus,
Soon it will be too late!

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Speak just a word for Jesus,
Why should you doubt or fear?
Surely His love will bless it;

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Speak just a word for Jesus,
Tell of His love for men!

title: Somebody Else Needs Him Too

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: need if He is loving and true,
if you  have found him a saviour indeed,

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Somebody somewhere perhaps at you side
somewhere is waiting for you Say  that
for all jesus suffered and died; they needs him

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: If you are happy, and praise fills your heart,
Trust him to carry you through
if He His Spirit and love can
impart Somebody else needs Him too..

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: If you have comfort in being God's child
If he is faithful to you Think when you see those whom
sin has defiled Somebody else needs Him, tooo..

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: When the lord gives you His love and grace
somethings he give you to do;
you have the gospel  with others to share

title: Somebody Needs Your Love

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Out in the darkness of sorrow and sin,
Led by the Master, that soul you may win,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Many are helpless, and wait for your call,
Show them that Jesus is all and in all,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Some one is tempted to turn from the right,
Longing for courage and strength for the fight,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Some are down-hearted, in sorrow they roam,
Many are sighing for heaven and home,

title: No One Like My Saviour

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: There’s no one like my Saviour,
No friend can be like Him;

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: No one, no one like my precious Saviour,
No one, no, such a friend can be;
No one, no one like my precious Saviour,
Glory, glory, Jesus cares for me.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: There’s no one like my Saviour;
He draws me closer to Him,
The strength of His right arm;
To keep me from all harm.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: There’s no one like my Saviour;
He leads me out to service
That I should be His child!

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: There’s no one like my Saviour,
Come now, and find it true;
He gave His life a ransom,
His blood was shed for you;
Then when we reach the City
We’ll sing with saints and angels,

title: Christ Receiveth Sinful Men

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Sound this word of grace to all
All who linger, all who fall.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Sing it o'er.. and o'er again...
Make the mes..sages clear and plain

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Now my heart condemns me not,
Pure before the law I stand;
He who cleansed me from all spot

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Even me with all my sin;
Purged from ev’ry spot and stain,
Heav’n with Him I enter in.

title: Wondeful Grace Of Jesus

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Wonderful Grace of Jesus, greater than all my sin;
How shall my tongue describe it,
Taking away my burden, setting my spirit free;
O the Wonderful Grace of Jesus reaches me!

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Wonderful the matchless Grace of Jesus,
Deeper than the mighty rolling sea;
Wonderful Grace, all sufficient for me, for even
Higher than the mountain, sparkling like a fountain,
All sufficient Grace for even me.
Broader than the scope of my transgressions,
Greater far than all my sin and shame
O magnify the precious name of Jesus,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Wonderful Grace of Jesus, reaching to all the lost;
By it I have been pardoned, saved to the uttermost.
Chains have been torn asunder, giving me liberty;
O the Wonderful Grace of Jesus, reaches me!

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Wonderful Grace of Jesus, reaching the most defiled;
Purchasing peace and Heaven, for all eternity;
And the Wonderful Grace of Jesus, reaches me!

title: Great God Of Wonders

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: But the fair glories of Thy grace

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Who is a pardoning God like Thee?
or Who has grace so rich and free?

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: In wonder lost, in trembling joy,
We take the pardon of our God:
Pardon for crimes of deepest dye,
A pardon bought with Jesus' blood.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Pardon - for sins of deepest dye!
Pardon - that brings the rebel nigh!

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Fill the wide earth with grateful praise,
And all the angelic chorus above!

title: Rock Of Ages Cleft For Me

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Rock of ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee;
Let the water and the blood,
From Thy wounded side which flowed,
Be of sin the double cure,
Cleanse me from its guilt and pow'r.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Nothing in my hands I bring,
Simply to Thy cross I cling;
Naked come to Thee for dress,
Helpless look to Thee for grace,
Foul I to the fountain fly,
Cleanse me, Saviour, or I die.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: While I draw this fleeting breath,
When mine eyes are closed in death;
While I soar through tracks unknown,
See Thee on Thy judgement throne,
Rock of ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee.

title: Vicory In Jesus

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: I heard an old, old story,
How a Savior came from glory,
How He gave His life on Calvary
To save a wretch like me;
Then I repented of my sins

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: He sought me and bought me
He loved me ere I knew Him
And all my love is due Him,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: How He made the lame to walk again
And caused the blind to see;
Come and heal my broken spirit,"
And somehow Jesus came and bro't

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: He has built for me in glory.
And I heard about the streets of gold
And some sweet day I'll sing up there

title: Grace Greater Than Our Sin

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Marvellous grace of our loving Lord,
Grace that exceeds our sin and our guilt,
There where the blood of the Lamb was split.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Grace that will pardon and cleanse within;
Grace that is greater than all our sin.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Sin and despair like the sea waves cold,
Threaten the soul with infinite loss;
Grace that is greater, yes, grace untold,
Points to the Refuge, the Mighty Cross.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Dark is the stain that we cannot hide,
What can avail to wash it away?
Look! there is flowing a crimson tide;
Whiter than snow you may be today.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Freely bestowed on all who believe;
You that are longing to see His face,
Will you this moment His grace receive?

title: Just As I Am Without One Plea

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Just as I am, without one plea,
But that Thy blood was shed for me,
And that Thou bid'st me come to Thee,
O Lamb of God, I come! I come!

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Just as I am, though tossed about
With many a conflict, many a doubt;
O Lamb of God, I come, I come!

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Just as I am, poor, wretched, blind;
Sight, riches, healing of the mind;
Yes, all I need, in Thee to find,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come!

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Just as I am, Thou wilt receive,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come!

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Just as I am, Thy love unknown
Now, to be Thine, yea, Thine alone,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come!

stanzas.label: Verse 6
lines: Just as I am, of that free love
The breadth, length, depth and height to prove,
Here for a season, then above,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

title: In Tenderness He Sought Me

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: And on His shoulders brought me
While angels in His presence sang,
Until the courts of heaven rang.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Oh, the love that sought me!
Oh, the blood that bought me!
Oh, the grace that brought me to the fold,
Wondrous grace that brought me to the fold!

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: And poured in oil and wine;
I never heard a sweeter voice,
It made my aching heart rejoice!

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: For me His blood was shed,
I wondered what He saw in me,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: It seems as if eternal days
Are far too short to sound His praise.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: So while the hours are passing,
When He will call us to His side,
To be with Him, His spotless bride.

title: Running Over

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Since the Saviour came to this heart of mine
My cups filled and running over
Filling my poor soul with his joy divine
My cup's filled and running over.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: My cups filled and running over
I'm as happy as can be
My cup's filled and running over

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: My cup's filled and running over
My cup's filled and running over

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: My cup's filled and running over
My cup's filled and running over

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: While the Angels round you hover
My Cup's filled and running over

title: Out Of My Bondage

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Out of my bondage, sorrow and night,
Jesus, I come, Jesus, I come;
Into Thy freedom, gladness and light,
Out of my sickness into Thy health,
Out of my want and into Thy wealth,
Out of my sin and into Thyself,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Out of unrest and arrogant pride,
Jesus, I come, Jesus, I come;
Into Thy blessed will to abide,
Out of myself to dwell in Thy love,
Out of despair into raptures above,
Upward for aye on wings like a dove,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Out of the fear and dread of the tomb,
Jesus I come, Jesus I come;
Into the joy and light of Thy home,
Out of the depths of ruin untold,
Into the peace of Thy sheltering fold,
Ever Thy glorious face to behold,

title: And Can It Be That I Should Gain

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: And can it be, that I should gain
An interest in the Saviour's blood?
Died He for me, who caused His pain?
For me, who Him to death pursued?
Amazing love! how can it be
That Thou, my God, shouldst die for me?

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: He left His Father's throne above
Emptied Himself of all but love,
And bled for Adam's helpless race;
For, O my God, it found out me!

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Fast bound in sin and nature's night;
Thine eye diffused a quickening ray,
I woke, the dungeon flamed with light;
My chains fell off, my heart was free,
I rose, went forth, and followed Thee.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Jesus, and all in Him, is mine;
Alive in Him, my living Head,
Bold I approach the eternal throne,
And claim the crown, through Christ my own.

title: Tell Me The Old Old Story

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Tell me the old, old story

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: For I am weak and weary,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: That I may take it in -

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: With the earnest tones and grave

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Tell me the same old story
When you have cause to fear
Yes, and when that world's glory
is dawning on my soul Tell me the old story

title: At Calvary

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Years I spent in vanity and pride,
Caring not my Lord was crucified,
Knowing not it was for me He died

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Mercy there was great and grace was free,
Pardon there was multiplied to me;
There my burden'd soul found liberty,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: By God's word at last my sin I learned,
Then I trembl'd at the law I'd spurn'd,
Till my guilty soul, imploring turned

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Now I've given to Jesus everything;
Now I gladly own Him as my King;
Now my raptured soul can only sing

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Oh, the love that drew salvation's plan!
Oh, the grace that brought it down to man!
Oh the mighty gulf that God did span

title: How Beautiful Heaven Must Be

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: We read of a place that’s called heaven,
It’s made for the pure and the free;
These truths in God’s Word He hath given,

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Sweet home of the happy and free;
Fair haven of rest for the weary,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: In heaven no drooping nor pining,
No wishing for elsewhere to be;
God’s light is forever there shining,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: I'm longing to go to fair heaven,
To be with the happpy an free
To spend the long ages in singing

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: The angels so sweetly are singing,
Up there by the beautiful sea;
Sweet chords from their gold harps are ringing,

title: When We All Get To Heaven

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Sing the wondrous love of Jesus,
Sing His mercy and His grace;
In the mansions bright and blessed,
He'll prepare for us a place.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: When we all get to heaven,
What a day of rejoicing that will be!
We'll sing and shout the victory.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: While we walk the pilgrim pathway
But when trav'ling days are over,
Not a shadow, not a sigh.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Let us then be true and faithful,
Just one glimpse of Him in glory
Will the toils of life repay.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Onward to the prize before us!
Soon the pearly gates will open,
We shall tread the streets of gold.

title: Beautiful Home

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: When, O when shall I see thee,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: How they swell the glad anthems
When, O when shall I see thee,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Soon shall I join that anthem,
Why should I fear to die?
Soon my eyes shall behold Him
Then, O then shall I see thee,

title: Laying My Treasure Up There

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: On the mountain of Zion beyond the blue sky,
Stands a city so wondrous and fair;
I expect to depart for that land, by and by,
For I'm laying my treasure up there.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: I am laying my treasure up there, up there,
In that beautiful city so fair;
For I'm laying my treasure up there.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: There's a mansion awaiting God's people, I'm told,
Which the Savior has gone to prepare;
There the walls are of jasper, the streets are of gold,
I am laying my treasure up there.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: All the love of my heart, and my soul, mind and strength,
And the work that with Jesus I share,
Are but some of the riches I'll find there at length,
For I'm laying my treasure up there.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: So altho' a poor pilgrim on earth I may roam,
Ever constant in watching and prayer,
Soon I'll hear the glad summons to start for my home,
For I'm laying my treasure up there.

title: I Shall See The King

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: I shall see the King some day,
And with Him shall ever stay.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: In His glory, I shall see the King,
’Twas on Calvary Jesus died for me;
I shall see the King some day.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Where there never comes a night,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: And shall look upon His face;
And has kept me by His grace.

title: Holy Holy Is What The Angels Sing

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: There is singing up in Heaven
such as we have never known,
Where the angels sing the praises
of the Lamb upon the throne,
Their sweet harps are ever tuneful,
O that we might be more like them
while we serve the Master here!

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Holy, holy, is what the angels sing,
And I expect to help them make the courts of Heaven ring;
But when I sing redemption’s story, they will fold their wings,
For angels never felt the joys that our salvation brings.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Unto Him who hath redeemed us
and hath bought us, is the song;
to this land so fair and bright,
He hath made our garments white.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Then the angels stand and listen,
for they cannot join the song,
Like the sound of many waters,
by that happy, blood washed throng,
For they sing about great trials,
And they praise their great Redeemer,
who hath said to them, Well done.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: So, although I’m not an angel,
yet I know that over there
I will join a blessèd chorus
I will sing about my Savior,
died to set a sinner free.

title: The End Of The Road

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: When I come to the end of the long, long road,
And I’ll stand in the glorious light of God,

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: When I come to the end, the end of the road,
When I come to the end of life’s long road,
The face of my Lord I’ll see.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Looking back o’er the years that were hard and drear,
The hand of the Christ I’ll see;
While my heart will go forth with a song of praise,
Because of His love for me.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: When I come to the end of the long, long road,
And trials will all be past,
I shall look in the face of my dearest Friend,
Safe home in His heav’n at last.

title: I Wont Have To Cross Jordan Alone

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: When I come to the river at the ending of day
When the last winds of sorrow have blown
There'll be somebody waiting to show me the way
I won't have to cross Jordan alone

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: I won't have to cross Jordan alone
Jesus died all my sins to atone
I won't have to cross Jordan alone

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Often times I'm weary and troubled and sad
When it seems that my friends have all flown
There is one thought that cheers me and makes my heart glad
I won't have to cross Jordan alone

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: I won't have to cross Jordan alone
Jesus died all my sins to atone
I won't have to cross Jordan alone

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Though the billows of trouble and sorrow may sweep
Christ the Savior will care for his own
Till the end of my journey my soul he will keep
And I won't have to cross Jordan alone

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: I won't have to cross Jordan alone
Jesus died all my sins to atone
I won't have to cross Jordan alone

title: When They Ring The Golden Bell

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: There’s a land beyond the river,
That we call the sweet forever,
And we only reach that shore by faith’s decree;
One by one we’ll gain the portals,
There to dwell with the immortals,
When they ring the golden bells for you and me.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Don’t you hear the bells now ringing?
Don’t you hear the angels singing?
When they ring the golden bells for you and me.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: We shall know no sin or sorrow,
When our barque shall sail beyond the silver sea;
We shall only know the blessing
When they ring the golden bells for you and me.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: When our days shall know their number,
And in death we sweetly slumber,
When the King commands the spirit to be free;
We shall reach that lovely Eden,
When they ring the golden bells for you and me

title: Face To Face

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Face to face with Christ, my Saviour,
Face to face – what will it be?
When with rapture I behold Him,
Jesus Christ who died for me.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Face to face I shall behold Him,
Face to face in all His glory,
I shall see Him by and by!

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Only faintly now, I see Him,
But a blessed day is coming,
When His glory shall be seen.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: When are banished grief and pain;
When the crooked ways are straightened,
And the dark things shall be plain.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Face to face! O blissful moment!
Face to face – to see and know;
Face to face with my Redeemer,
Jesus Christ who loves me so.

title: Sweet By And By

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: There's a land that is fairer than day,
And by faith we can see it afar;
For the Father waits over the way
To prepare us a dwelling place there.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on that beautiful shore;
In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on that beautiful shore.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: We shall sing on that beautiful shore
The melodious songs of the blessed;
And our spirits shall sorrow no more,
Not a sigh for the blessing of rest.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: We will offer our tribute of praise
For the glorious gift of His love
And the blessings that hallow our days.

title: No Tears In Heaven

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: 1. No tears in heaven, no sorrows given.
All will be glory in that land;
There'll be no sadness, all will be gladness,
When we shall join that happy band.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: No tears No tears, no tears up there,
Sorrow and pain will all have flown;
No tears No tears, no tears up there;
No tears in heaven will be known.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Glory is waiting, waiting up yonder,
Where we shall spend an endless day;
There with our Savior, we'll be forever,
Where no more sorrow can dismay.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Some morning yonder, we'll cease to ponder
O'er things this life has brought to view;
All will be clearer, loved ones be dearer
In heav'n where all will be made new.

title: Farther Along

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Tempted and tried we're oft made to wonder
Why it should be thus all the day long,
While there are others living about us,
Never molested tho' in the wrong.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Farther along we'll know all about it,
Cheer up, my brother, live in the sunshine,
We'll understand it all by and by.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: When death has come and taken our loved ones,
It leaves our home so lonely and drear;
Then do we wonder why others prosper,
Living so wicked year after year.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Faithful till death said our loving Master,
A few more days to labour and wait;
Toils of the road will then seem as nothing,
As we sweep through the beautiful gate.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: When we see Jesus coming in glory,
When He comes from His home in the sky;
Then we shall meet Him in that bright mansion,
We'll understand it all by and by.

title: Pentecostal Power

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, as of old, at Pentecost,

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Lord, send the old-time power, the Pentecostal power!
Thy floodgates of blessing, on us throw open wide!
Lord, send the old-time power, the Pentecostal power!
That sinners be converted and Thy Name glorified!

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: For mighty works for Thee, prepare
Come, take possession of Thine own,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: All self consume, all sin destroy!
Each waiting heart to work for Thee;

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Speak, Lord! before Thy throne we wait,
And will not let Thee go until

title: There Shall Be Showers Of Blessing

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: This is the promise of love;

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Mercy drops round us are falling,
But for the showers we plead.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Over the hills and the valleys,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Send them upon us O Lord!
Grant to us now a refreshing;
Come, and now honour Thy Word.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Oh, that today they might fall,
Now as to God we're confessing,
Now as on Jesus we call.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: If we but trust and obey;
If we let God have His way.

title: Joys Are Flowing Like A River

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Joys are flowing like a river,
He abides with us for ever,
Makes the trusting heart His home.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: On the stormy sea, He speaks peace to me,
How the billows cease to roll.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Bringing life, and health, and gladness,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Like the rain that falls from heaven,
Like the sunlight from the sky,
So the Holy Ghost is given,
Coming on us from on high.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Where we always see His face;

title: With Signs Following

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: When first the risen Lord of pow'r
A charge he gave, that solemn hour,
Declare My Word, and ye shall find:
These signs shall surely follow them

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: The sick beneath their hands, by prayer,
Shall rise, to prove My Word,"
So let it be! Firm as His Throne
Stands this clear promise to His own:
These signs shall surely follow them

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Crowned with the flame of Pentecost,
Proclaimed His Name: a ransomed host
The Lord worked with them from on High,
His proven Word could none deny:
These signs shall surely follow them

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: No word of Thine is void of power;
Nor can'st Thou fail! Thou art the same
As when of old Thou did'st' proclaim:
These signs shall surely follow them

title: Give Me A Double Portion

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Long ago in days of old, stood a man of God we're told,
As he talked to Elijah that day;
His request he did repeat, standing at Elijah's feet,
"A double portion" I can hear him say.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Give me, Lord, a double portion, pour Thy Spirit on me,
Thru eyes of faith Thy wondrous works I can see,
But I need Thy helping hand, in this troubled, sinful land,
Give me, Lord, a double portion from Thee.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: As Elijah stood that day, to Elisha he did say,
"Ask me what I shall do unto thee,"
And Elisha then replied, walking at Elijah's side,
"A double portion, let it fall on me."

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Lord, I always to Thee, pray, just for strength from day to day,
But I see there's so much to be done,
That I have to kneel anew and this favor ask of you,
A double portion -- this fight must be won.

title: Let Jesus Come Into Your Heart

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: If you are tired of the load of your sin,
Let Jesus come into your heart;
If you desire a new life to begin,
Let Jesus come into your heart.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Just now, your doubtings give o'er;
Just now, reject Him no more;
Just now, throw open the door;
Let Jesus come into your heart.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: If it's for purity now that you sigh,
Let Jesus come into your heart;
Fountains for cleansing are flowing nearby,
Let Jesus come into your heart.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: If there's a tempest your voice cannot still,
Let Jesus come into your heart;
If there's a void this world never can fill,
Let Jesus come into your heart.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: If you would join the glad songs of the blest,
Let Jesus come into your heart;
If you would enter the mansions of rest,
Let Jesus come into your heart.

title: Room At The Cross For You

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: The cross upon which Jesus died
Is a shelter in which we can hide
And its grace so free is sufficient for me
And deep is its fountain as wide as the sea.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: There's room at the cross for you
There's room at the cross for you
Though millions have come, there's still room for one
Yes there's room at the cross for you.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Though millions have found him a friend
And have turned from the sins they have sinned
The Savior still waits to open the gates
And welcome a sinner before it's too late.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: The hand of my Savior is strong
And the love of my Savior is long
Through sunshine or rain, through loss or in gain,
The blood flows from Calvary to cleanse every stain.

title: Wandering Child O Come Home

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Have you wandered away from your Father's care,
Heavy hearted and sad do you roam?
There's a sweet gentle voice calling now to you
Wand-ring child, wand'ring child, O come home.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Child, come home, child come home,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Is your frail bark adrift on life's raging sea,
Are you tossed on its billows and foam?
There's a safe harbor home, waiting now for you
Wand-ring child, wand'ring child, O come home.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: He is pleading today, heed His gentle voice,
As He bids you no longer to roam,
To that dear Father's house haste without delay--
Wand-ring child, wand'ring child, O come home.

title: Come Believing

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: From the Saviour you have heard;
Will you turn and seek the Lord?

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Come to Jesus, look and live!
Come to Jesus, look and live!

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Winter snows by Spring have melted,
Yet you linger in your sin.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Jesus for your choice is waiting;
While the Spirit now is striving,
Yield, and seek the Saviour's side.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Cease of fitness to be thinking;
Do not longer try to feel!
It is trusting, and not feeling,
That will give the Spirit's seal.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Let your will to God be given,
Look to Jesus now in heaven,

title: Why Do You Wait

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Why do you wait, dear brother,
Oh, why do you tarry so long?
Your Saviour is waiting to give you
A place in His sanctified throng.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Why not come to Him now?
Why not come to Him now?

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: What do you hope, dear brother,
To gain by a further delay?
There’s no one to save you but Jesus,
There’s no other way but His way.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Do you not feel, dear brother,
Oh, why not accept His salvation,
And throw off thy burden of sin.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Why do you wait, dear brother,
Your Saviour is longing to bless you,
There’s danger and death in delay.

title: The Shepherd Of Love

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: The Shepherd of Love is seeking the lost
In paths that are rough and steep;
He’s calling the lambs that have gone astray,

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Out of your darkness of sin and shame,
Into His love, forever the same,
Come to Him now, believe on His name,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: The Shepherd of Love knows His sheep by name,
O weary one, come to the Shepherd’s fold,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: The Shepherd of Love our ransom hath paid,
He’s patiently waiting for thee to come,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: The Shepherd of Love now seeketh His sheep,
Behold, He is calling the wand’rer home,

title: Who'll Be The Next To Follow Jesus

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Who'll be the next to follow Jesus?
Who’ll be the next his cross to bear?
Someone is ready, someone is waiting;
Who’ll be the next a crown to wear?

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Who’ll be the next, who’ll be the next?
Who’ll be the next to follow Jesus?
Who’ll be the next to follow les us now?

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Who’ll be the next to follow Jesus?
Come and bow at his precious feet;
Who’ll be the next to lay every burden
Down at the Father’s mercy seat?

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Who’ll be the next to follow Jesus?
Who’ll be the next to praise his name?
Who’ll swell the chorus of free redemption,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Who’ll be the next to follow Jesus
Down through the Jordan’s rolling tide?
Who’ll be the next to join with the ransomed

title: Almost Persuaded

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Seems now some soul to say,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Oh, be persuaded! Christ never fails—
Oh, be persuaded! His blood avails—
Will you not let Him in?

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Be now persuaded, oh, sinner, hear!
Be now persuaded, Jesus is near;
Turn now with heart and will,

title: My God Is An Hour So Sweet

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: My God, is any hour so sweet
From blush of morn to evening star,
As that which calls me to Thy feet,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: No words can tell what sweet relief
There for my ev'ry want I find.
What strength for warfare, balm for grief,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Hushed is each doubt, gone ev'ry fear;
My spirit seems in heav’n to stay;

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Lord, till I reach yon blissful shore,
No privilege so dear shall be
As thus my inmost soul to pour

title: Prayer Is The Soul S Sincere Desire

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Prayer is the soul’s sincere desire,
The motion of a hidden fire

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Prayer is the simplest form of speech
Prayer the sublimest strains that reach

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Prayer is the Christian’s vital breath,
His watchword at the gates of death;

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: The saints in prayer appear as one,
In word, and deed, and mind;
While with the Father and the Son

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: O Thou, by whom we come to God,
he Life, the Truth, the Way,
The path of prayer Thyself hast trod—
Lord, teach us how to pray.

title: Guide Me O Thou Great Jehovah

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Guide me, O Thou Great Jehovah!
I am weak, but Thou art mighty,
Hold me by Thy pow'rful hand:
Bread of heaven! Bread of heaven!
Feed me now and ever more,
Feed me now and ever more.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: If I tread the verge of Jordan,
Bear me through the swelling torrent,
Land me safe on Canaan's side:
Songs of praises! Songs of praises!
I will ever give to Thee,
I will ever give to Thee.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Saviour, come! we long to see Thee,
Long to dwell with Thee above;
And to know in full communion,
All the sweetness of Thy love.
Come, Lord Jesus! Come, Lord Jesus!

title: Did You Think To Pray

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Ere you left your room this morning
In the name of Christ, our Saviour,
Did you sue for loving favour,

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: O how praying rests the weary!
Prayer will change the night to day;
So when life seems dark and dreary,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: When you met with great temptation
By His dying love and merit
Did you claim the Holy Spirit

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: When your heart was filled with anger
Did you plead for grace, my brother,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: When sore trials came upon you
When your soul was bowed in sorrow,
Balm of Gilead did you borrow

title: I Must Tell Jesus

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: I must tell Jesus all of my trials;
I cannot bear these burdens alone;
In my distress He kindly will help me;
He ever loves and care for His own.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: I must tell Jesus! I must tell Jesus!
I cannot bear my burdens alone;
I must tell Jesus! I must tell Jesus!
Jesus will help me, Jesus alone.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: I must tell Jesus all of my troubles;
He is a kind, compassionate Friend;
If I but ask Him, He will deliver,
Make of my troubles quickly an end.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Tempted and tried, I need a great Saviour,
One Who can help my burdens to bear;
I must tell Jesus, I must tell Jesus;
He all my cares and sorrows will share.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: O how the world to evil allures me!
O how my heart is tempted to sin!
I must tell Jesus, and He will help me
Over the world the victory to win.

title: I Need Thee Every Hour

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: I need Thee, oh, I need Thee,
Oh, bless me now, my Saviour,

title: What A Friend We Have In Jesus

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: 1. What a Friend we have in Jesus,
All our sins and griefs to bear;
Oh, what peace we often forfeit,
Oh, what needless pain we bear -
All because we do not carry

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: 3. Are we weak and heavy laden,
Cumbered with a load of care?
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Do thy friends despise, forsake thee?
Take it to the Lord in prayer.

title: Sweet Hour Of Prayer

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Sweet hour of pray'r! Sweet hour of pray'r!
That calls me from a world of care
And bids me at my Father's throne
Make all my wants and wishes known;
In seasons of distress and grief,
My soul has often found relief,
And oft escaped the tempter's snare
By thy return sweet hour of pray'r.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Sweet hour of pray'r! Sweet hour of pray'r!
Till from Mount Pisgah's lofty height,
I view my home and take my flight:

lines: O blessèd hope! O blissful promise!

Fill my poor heart with Thy great love divine;
Take all my will, my passion, self and pride;
I now surrender – Lord, in me abide.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: O Holy Ghost, revival comes from Thee;
Send a revival – start the work in me:
Thy Word declares Thou wilt supply our need;
For blessing now, O Lord, I humbly plead.

title: Fill My Cup Lord

stanzas.label: Verse 1

For things that could not satisfy;
And then I heard my Saviour speaking –
"Draw from My well that never shall run dry."

stanzas.label: Chorus

Bread of heaven, feed me till I want no more-
Fill my cup, fill it up and make me whole!

lines: There are millions in this world who are craving –
But none can match the wondrous treasure –
That I find in Jesus Christ, my Lord.

stanzas.label: Verse 3

Leave hungers that won't pass away,
My blessed Lord will come and save you
If you kneel to Him and humbly pray:

stanzas.label: Verse 1

stanzas.label: Chorus

All things are possible to me.

stanzas.label: Verse 4

Holy, and pure, and perfect here,

All things are possible to me.

stanzas.label: Verse 4

stanzas.label: Verse 5
