stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: The widow was there with the orphans,
God heard and remembered their cries;
No sorrow in heaven for ever,
God wiped all the tears from their eyes;
The gambler was there and the drunkard,
And the man that had sold them the drink,
With the people who gave him the license,
Together in hell they did sink.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: The moral man came to the judgment,
But his self-righteous rags would not do;
The men who had crucified Jesus
Had passed off as moral men too;
The soul that had put off salvation,
"Not tonight; I'll get saved by and by,
No time now to think of religion!"
At last they had found time to die.

title: I Will Not Forget Thee

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Sweet is the promise - "I will not forget thee,"
Nothing can molest or turn my soul away;
E'en tho' the night be dark within the valley,
Just beyond is shining an eternal day.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: I will not forget thee or leave thee;
In my hands I'll hold thee, in my arms I'll fold thee;
I will not forget thee or leave thee;
I am thy Redeemer, I will care for thee.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Trusting the promise - "I will not forget thee,"
Onward will I go with songs of joy and love;
Tho' earth despise me, tho' my friends forsake me,
I shall be remembered in my home above.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: When at the golden portals I am standing,
All my tribulations, all my sorrows past,
How sweet to hear the blessed proclamation,
"Enter, faithful servant, welcome home at last!"

title: Open My Eyes That I May See

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Open my eyes, that I may see
Glimpses of truth Thou hast for me;
Place in my hands the wonderful key
That shall unclasp and set me free.
Open my ears, that I may hear
Voices of truth Thou sendest clear;
And while the wave notes fall on my ear,
Open my mouth, and let me bear,
Open my heart and let me prepare
Love with Thy children thus to share.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Open my way, that i may bring
Trophies of grace to Thee, my King
Echoed in love Thy word shall out ring
Sweet as the note that angels sing
Silently now i wait for thee
Ready, my God, Thy will to see
Open my way, illuminate me, Spirit Divine!

title: Crown Him With Many Crowns

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Hark! how the heavenly anthem drowns
of him who died for thee,
and hail him as thy matchless king

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Crown him the Lord of love;
but downward bends their burning eye

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Crown him the Lord of years,
for thou hast died for me;
thy praise shall never, never fail

title: Jesus Shall Reign

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus shall reign where'er the sun
his kingdom stretch from shore to shore,
till moons shall wax and wane no more.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: People and realms of every tongue
dwell on his love with sweetest song,
their early blessings on his name.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: the prisoners leap to lose their chains,
and all who suffer want are blest.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Let every creature rise and bring
the highest honors to our King,
and earth repeat the loud amen.

title: Rejoice The Lord Is King

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: He rules o'er earth and heav'n;
The keys of death and hell

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Our Lord and judge shall come

title: All Hail The Power Of Jesus

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: All hail the power of Jesus' name!
and crown him Lord of all.
and crown him Lord of all!

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Let every tongue and every tribe
and crown him Lord of all.
and crown him Lord of all!

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Oh, that with all the sacred throng
we at his feet may fall!
and crown him Lord of all.
and crown him Lord of all.

title: Ohappy Day That Fixed My Choice

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: O happy day, that fixed my choice
On Thee, my Saviour and my God!
Well may this glowing heart rejoice,
And tell its raptures all abroad.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: O happy bond, that seals my vows
To Him Who merits all my love!
Let cheerful anthems fill His house,
While to that sacred shrine I move.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: I am the Lord's and He is mine;
He drew me, and I followed on;
Charmed to confess the voice divine.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Now rest, my long divided heart,
Fixed on this blissful centre, rest.
Here have I found a nobler part;
Here heavenly pleasures fill my breast.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: High heaven, that heard the solemn vow,
That vow renewed shall daily hear,
Till in life's latest hour I bow
And bless in death a bond so dear.

title: More About Jesus Would I Know

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: More about Jesus would I know,
More of His grace to others show;
More of His saving fullness see,
More of His love who died for me.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: More of His saving fullness see,
More of His love who died for me.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: More about Jesus let me learn,
More of His holy will discern;
Spirit of God, my teacher be,
Showing the things of Christ to me.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: More about Jesus, in His Word,
Hearing His voice in every line,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: More about Jesus on His throne,
Riches in glory all His own;
More of His kingdom's sure increase;
More of His coming, Prince of Peace.

title: O Perfect Love All Human Thought Transcending

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: O perfect Love, all human thought transcending,
lowly we kneel in prayer before thy throne,
that theirs may be the love which knows no ending,
whom thou in sacred vow dost join in one.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Grant them the joy which brightens earthly sorrow;
grant them the peace which calms all earthly strife;
grant them the vision of the glorious morrow
that will reveal eternal love and life.

title: Love Divine All Loves

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Joy of heaven, to earth come down;
Fix in us Thy humble dwelling;

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Let us all Thy life receive;
Thee we would be always blessing,
Pray, and praise Thee without ceasing,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Pure and spotless let us be;
Let us see Thy great salvation,
Till in heaven we take our place,
Till we cast our crowns before Thee,
Lost in wonder, love, and praise.

title: More More Holiness Give Me
When I Saw The Cleansing Fountain

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: 1 When I saw the cleansing fountain,
Open wide for all my sin,
When He said, “Wilt thou be clean?”

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: I will praise Him! I will praise Him!
Praise the Lamb for sinners slain;
Give Him glory, all ye people,
For His blood can wash away each stain.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Tho' the way seems straight and narrow,
All I claimed was swept away;
At my feet in ashes lay.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Blessed be the name of Jesus!
I’m so glad He took me in;
He has cleansed my heart from sin.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Glory to the Three in One!

title: Lets Not Thy Hands Be Slack

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Let not thy hands be slack,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Let not thy hands be slack,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Let not thy hands be slack,
Press on for Truth and Right,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Let not thy hands be slack,
Then be not slack of hand!
Help thou the weak to stand!

title: Speed Thy Servants Saviour Speed Them

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Speed thy servants, Saviour, speed them;
Thou art Lord of winds and waves;
They were bound, but thou hast freed them;
Now they go to free the slaves:
Be thou with them, 'Tis thine arm alone that save.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Where no fruit appears to cheer them,
And they seem to toil in vain,
Then in mercy, Lord, draw near them,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Let them trust, O Lord, in thee;
Till thy face in heav'n they see.
Till thy face in heav'n they see.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: There to reap in joy forever,
Fruit that grows from seed here sown
There to be with him who never Ceases to preserve His
own; And with gladness, Give the praise to Him alone

title: I Gave My Life For Thee

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: I gave my life for thee,
I gave, I gave My life for thee –
What hast thou giv'n for me?

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: More than thy tongue can tell,
I've borne, I've borne it all for thee –
What hast thou borne for me?

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: And I have brought to thee,
I bring, I bring rich gifts to thee –
What hast thou brought to Me?

title: Oh The Bitter Shame And Sorrow

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: O the bitter shame and sorrow,
That a time could ever be,
When I let the Savior’s pity
Plead in vain, and proudly answered,
All of self, and none of Thee!

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Day by day His tender mercy,
Sweet and strong, and ah! so patient,
Brought me lower, while I whispered,
Less of self, and more of Thee!

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Lord, Thy love at last hath conquered:
None of self, and all of Thee!

title: Burn Fire Of God

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Burn fire of God! my ransomed soul possessing;
Pure fire Thou art, and I would dwell in Thee.
Light of my life, true source of every blessing,
Grant all my days one holy flame to be.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Burn fire of God! Thy cloven tongue bestowing,
Touched with live coals from off Thine altar glowing,
My purgèd  lips shall speak alone of Thee.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Burn fire of God! with seven-fold refining,
Till, mirrored from my deeps Thine eyes shall see
In purest gold Thy perfect image shining:
Thy Christ revealed in clear irradiancy.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Burn fire of God! by Thine own love transcending,
Let all I hold be Thine, and Thine alone!
Heart, mind and will a sacrifice ascending,
Consumed by fire from out Thy fiery Throne.

title: Thy Blessed Will Divine

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: I want my life to be all filled with praise to Thee,
My precious Lord divine Who died for me,
Let all my will be Thine, Controlled by love divine
Live out in me Thy life, O Mighty Saviour.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Thy blessed will divine, with joy I make it mine,
My heart shall be Thy throne, and Thine alone.
Choose Thou the path I tread and whither, I am led,
Help me to follow on, O mighty Saviour.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: A pilgrim born anew, a stranger going through,
Not of this world am I, since I am Thine.
Weaned from its passing show, transformed Thy love to know,
Hold Thou my hand in Thine, O mighty Saviour.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: When evil foes assail and almost would prevail,
In that dark hour be Thou my strength and shield.
Lend then Thy strong embrace, uphold me by Thy grace,
In weakness be my strength, O mighty Saviour.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Yea, choose the path for me, although I may not see,
The reason Thou dost will to lead me so.
I know the toilsome way will lead to realms of day,
Where I shall dwell with Thee, O mighty Saviour.

title: Nearer My God To Thee

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Nearer, my God, to Thee, nearer to Thee!
E’en though it be a cross that raiseth me,
Still all my song shall be, nearer, my God, to Thee.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: There let the way appear, steps unto Heav’n;
All that Thou sendest me, in mercy given;
Angels to beckon me nearer, my God, to Thee.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Then, with my waking thoughts bright with Thy praise,
Out of my stony griefs Bethel I’ll raise;
So by my woes to be nearer, my God, to Thee.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Or, if on joyful wing cleaving the sky,
Sun, moon, and stars forgot, upward I’ll fly,
Still all my song shall be, nearer, my God, to Thee.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: There in my Father’s home, safe and at rest,
There in my Savior’s love, perfectly blest;
Age after age to be, nearer my God to Thee.

title: O Why Not Tonight

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Oh, do not let thy Lord depart,
And close thine eyes against the light;
Poor sinner, harden not thy heart;

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: O why not tonight? O why not to-night?

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: This is the time!—oh, then, be wise!

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Our God in pity lingers still;
Oh, wilt thou thus His love requite?
Renounce at length thy stubborn will,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Who would to Him their souls unite;
Believe, obey the work is done

title: Hold The Fort

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Ho, my comrades! see the signal

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: "Hold the fort, for I am coming,"
Wave the answer back to heaven,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: In our Leader's name we'll triumph

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Fierce and long the battle rages,

title: Bring Your Vessel Not A Few

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Are you longing for the fullness
Of the blessing of the Lord
In your heart and life today?
Claim the promise of your Father;
In the blessèd, old time way.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: He will fill your heart today to overflowing.
He will fill your heart today to overflowing
With the Holy Ghost and power.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Come, ye needy, one and all;
Wait before the throne of God
Till the Holy Ghost shall fall.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Like the cruse of oil unfailing
With the Holy Ghost and power

title: Send The Light

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: There's a call comes ringing o'er the restless wave,
There are souls to rescue, there are souls to save,
Send the light! Send the light!

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Send the light, the blessed Gospel light;
Let it shine from shore to shore!
Send the light, and let its radiant beams,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: We have heard the Macedonian call today,
And a golden off'ring at the cross we lay,
Send the light! Send the light!

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Let us pray that grace may everywhere abound,
And a Christ-like spirit everywhere be found,
Send the light! Send the light!

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Let us not grow weary in the work of love,
Let us gather jewels for a crown above,
Send the light! Send the light!

title: Blest Be The Tie That Binds

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Blest be the tie that binds

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: And often for each other flows

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: But we shall still be joined in heart,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: And longs to see the day.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: And sin, we shall be free,
And perfect love and friendship reign

title: Stand Up Stand Up For Jesus

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Stand up, stand up for Jesus!

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Stand up, stand up for Jesus!
The arm of flesh will fail you;
Ye dare not trust your own:
Each piece put on with prayer;

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Stand up, stand up for Jesus!
The strife will not be long;
This day the noise of battle,
A crown of life shall be;
He with the King of glory

title: O Lord With One Accord

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: we gather round Thy holy throne
Now send from heaven the Holy ghost

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Where is the mighty wind That
shook the holy place that gladdened
every mind and brightened every face?
And where the cloven tongues of flames
That marked each follower of the Lamb?

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: There is no chance in Thee, Lord God the Holy Ghost,
Thy glorious majesty Is as a Pentecost!
O may our loosened tongues proclaim
That Thou our God art still the same

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: And may the living wave That issues from on high,
whose golden waters lave thy eternally
Flow doen in power on us to-day,
And none shall go unblessed away

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Anoint us with Thy grace, to yield ourselves to Thee
To run our daily grace with joy and energy
until we hear the Bridegroom say,
"Rise up my love and come and stay"

title: The Holy Spirit's Power

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Ye need th master said "So wait till comes
the hours when on you He is shed so praise
did all their soul employ as tarried they

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Heaven's life their hearts has thrilled,
"Is the gift, since Christ has bled."

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Come now, ye sons of men This message now received ,
The holy spirit given To all believe;
Ye, too, may know His mighty power,
And speak with tongues this very hour.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: For these your zeal shall never tire
To snatch them from the everlsating fire.

title: Lord God The Holyghost

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: As on the day of Pentecost,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Move with one impulse every mind;

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: And give us hearts and tongues of fire,
To pray, and praise, and love.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: With luster shining more and more

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: In life and death, our guide;

title: Peace Perfect Peace

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Peace, perfect peace, in this dark world of sin?
The blood of Jesus whispers peace within.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Peace, perfect peace, with sorrows surging round?
On Jesus' bosom naught but calm is found.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Peace, perfect peace, with loved ones far away?
In Jesus' keeping we are safe, and they.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Peace, perfect peace, our future all unknown?
Jesus we know, and He is on the throne.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Peace, perfect peace, death shadowing us and ours?
Jesus has vanquished death and all its powers.

stanzas.label: Verse 6
lines: It is enough: earth's struggles soon shall cease,
And Jesus call us to heaven's perfect peace

title: Thou Hidden Source Of Calm Repose

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Thou hidden source of calm repose,
my help and refuge from my foes,
secure i am, if thou art mine:
and lo, from sin, and grief, and shame,
I hide me, Jesus, in thy name.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Jesus, my all in all thou art:
my rest in toil, my ease in pain,
the medicine of my broken heart,
in war my peace, in loss my gain,
my smile beneath the tyrant's frown,
in shame my glory and my crown;

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: my light in Satan's darkest hour,
my life in death, my heaven,my all.

title: One There Is Above All Others

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: One there is, above all others,
well deserves the name of Friend;
his is love beyond a brother's,
costly, free, and knows no end.
They who once his kindness prove

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: When he lived on earth abased,
still he calls them brethren, friends,
and to all their wants attends.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: O for grace our hearts to soften!
Teach us, Lord, at length to love;
what a Friend we have above:
but when home our souls are brought,
we will love you as we ought.

title: Jesus Is The Same Forever

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: As Of Old, So Now Today;
All The Host Of Hell Endeavour

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: From His Ha No Power Can Sever
Those Who In Their Lord Confide,
Sweetly From All Care He Frees Us,
Ours The Comfort His The Shame
There’s No Music Like Thy Name.

title: I've Found The Pearl Of Greatest Peice

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: I've found the pearl of greatest price,
My heart doth sing for joy:
And sing I must, a Christ I have;
O what a Christ have I?

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Christ is a prophet, priest and king,
A Priest that stands 'twixt God and man,
A King that rules with might.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Christ's manhood is a temple, where
My Christ, he is the sacrifice,
My Christ he is the priest.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: My Christ he is the Lord of lords,
He is the King of kings;
He is the Sun of righteousness,

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: My Christ, he is the Tree of Life,
Whose fruit does feed, whose leaves do heal;

stanzas.label: Verse 6
lines: Christ is my meat, Christ is my drink,
My peace, my strength, my joy, my crown,

stanzas.label: Verse 7
lines: Christ is my father, and my friend,
My head, my hope, my counselor,

stanzas.label: Verse 8
lines: My Christ, he is the Heaven of heavens,
My Christ what shall I call?
My Christ is first, my Christ is last,
My Christ is all in all.

title: A Good High Priest Is Come

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: A good High Priest is come,
the law by Aaron's priesthood came,
but grace and truth by Jesus' name.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: and by the throne He stands,
there shows how He was slain,
our Priest abides and pleads the cause
of us who have transgressed His laws.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: He shall have all the praise: for He
has loved, and died, and lives for me.

title: Standing On The Promises

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Standing on the promises of Christ my King,
Through eternal ages let His praises ring;
Glory in the highest I will shout and sing,
Standing on the promises of God.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Standing on the promises of God my Saviour;
I'm standing on the promises of God.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Standing on the promises that cannot fail,
When the howling storms of doubt and fear assail,
By the living Word of God I shall prevail,
Standing on the promises of God.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Standing on the promises I now can see
Perfect, present cleansing in the blood for me;
Standing in the liberty where Christ makes free,
Standing on the promises of God.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Standing on the promises of Christ the Lord,
Bound to Him eternally by love's strong cord,
Overcoming daily by the Spirit's sword,
Standing on the promises of God.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Standing on the promises I cannot fall,
List'ning ev'ry moment to the Spirit's call,
Resting in my Saviour, as my all in all,
Standing on the promises of God.

title: All Things In Jesus

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Friends all around me are trying to find
What the heart yearns for by sin undermined;
I have the secret, I know where 'tis found:
Only true pleasures in Jesus abound.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: All that I want is in Jesus.
Life would be worthless without Him;
All things in Jesus I find.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Some carry burdens whose weight has for years
Crushed them with sorrow and blinded with tears.
Yet One stands ready to help them just now,
If they will humbly in penitence bow.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: No other name thrills the joy chords within,
And through none else is remission of sin.
He knows the pain of the heart sorely tried.
Both need and want will by Him be supplied.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Jesus is all this poor world needs today.
Blindly they strive, for sin darkens their way.
O to draw back the grim curtains of night,
One glimpse of Jesus and all will be bright!

title: Is Your Life A Channel Of Blessing

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Is your life a channel of blessing?
Is the love of God flowing through you?
Are you telling the lost of the Savior?
Are you ready His service to do?

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Make me a channel of blessing today,
Make me a channel of blessing, I pray;
My life possessing, my service blessing,
Make me a channel of blessing today.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Is your life a channel of blessing?
Are you burdened for those that are lost?
Have you urged upon those who are straying
The Savior Who died on the cross?

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Is your life a channel of blessing?
Is it a daily telling for Him?
Have you spoken the Word of salvation
To those who are dying in sin?

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: We cannot be channels of blessing
If our lives are not free from known sin;
We will barriers be and a hindrance
To those we are trying to win.

title: O Brother Life S Journey Beginning

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Look well to the course thou art choosing;
Be earnest, be watchful, and wise!
But one leadeth on to destruction,
The other to joy and delight.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: God help you to follow His banner,
And serve Him wherever you go;
And when you are tempted, my brother,
God give you the grace to say No!

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: O brother, yield not to the tempter,
No matter what others may do;
Stand firm in the strength of the Master,
Be loyal, be faithful, and true!
Each trial will make you the stronger,
If you, in the name of the Lord,
Obeying the voice of His Word.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: O brother, the Savior is calling!
Beware of the danger of sin;
Resist not the voice of the Spirit,
God calls you to enter His service—
To live for Him here, day by day;
And share by and by in the glory

title: The Finished The Messiah Dies

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: cut off for sins, but not his own.
the great redeeming work is done.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: 'Tis finished! All my guilt and pain,
for me, for me the Lamb is slain;

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: The reign of sin and death is o'er,
and all may live from sin set free;
Satan hath lost his mortal power;

title: The Mercy Seat

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: From ev'ry stormy wind that blows,
from ev'ry swelling tide of woes,
there is a calm, a sure retreat;

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: There is a spot where spirits blend,
where friend holds fellowship with friend,
tho' sundered far; by faith they meet

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Ah, whither could we flee for aid,
or how the hosts of hell defeat,
had suff'ring saints no mercy seat?

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: There, there on eagle wings we soar,
and time and sense seem all no more,
and heav'n comes down our souls to greet,
and glory crowns the mercy seat.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: O may my hand forget her skill,
my tongue be silent, cold, and still,
this bounding heart forget to beat,
if I forget the mercy seat.

title: Come Sing The Praise Of Jesus

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Come sing the praise of Jesus
Sing His love with hearts aflame,
Sing his wondrous birth of Mary
when to save the world He came;
Tell the life he lived for others

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Praise and glory be to Jesus,
praise and glory be to Jesus,
praise and glory be to Jesus,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: When foes arose and slew Him,
He was victor in the fight;
Over death and hell He triumphed
He has raised our fallen manhood
And enthroned it in the height,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: There’s joy for all who serve Him,
More than human tongue can say;
There is pardon for the sinner,
And the night is turned to day;
There is healing for our sorrows,
There is music all the way,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: And we spread His love abroad;
And we cleave the hosts of darkness,
We will lead the souls in prison
To the freedom of the Lord,

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: He is Lord of all creation,
He is guide of all our ways;
And the world shall be His empire
In the fulness of the days

title: For My Sake And The Gospel S Go

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: 'For my sake and the gospel's, go
and thine, Lord, all the glory!'
They preach his birth, his life, his cross,
for whom they count the world but loss,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Still on and on the anthems spread
In concert with the holy dead
Their snow white robes are washed in blood,
Earth and the paradise of God

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: He comes, whose advent trumpet drowns
the Lord of saints and angels.
O Life, Light, Love, the great I AM,
the throne of God and of the Lamb
is thine, and thine for ever.

title: Only Remembered

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Fading away like the stars of the morning
Losing their light in the glorious sun,
Thus would we pass from the earth and its toiling,
Only remembered by what we have done.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Only remembered by what we have done,
Thus would we pass from the earth and its toiling,
Only remembered by what we have done.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Shall we be missed, tho' by others succeeded,
Reaping the fields we in springtime have sown?
Yes, but the sowers must pass from their labours,
Ever remembered by what they have done.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Only the truth that in life we have spoken,
Only the seed that on earth we have sown,
These shall pass onward when we are forgotten,
Fruits of the harvest and what we have done.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Oh, when the Saviour shall make up His jewels,
When the bright crowns of rejoicing are won,
Then shall His weary and faithful disciples
All be remembered by what they have done.

title: It Is Morning In My Heart

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: All the darkness of the night has passed away,
It is morning in my heart;
I am living in the sunlight of the day,
It is morning in my heart.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: It is morning, it is morning in my heart;
Jesus made the gloomy shadows all depart.
Songs of gladness now I sing,
For since Jesus is my King
It is morning, it is morning in my heart.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: I can the songbirds their refain,
It is morning in my heart;
And i know that life for me begins
again, It is morning in my heart

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Christ has made the world a paradise to me,
It is morning in my heart;
Every duty in the light of love I see,
It is morning in my heart.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Joy has come to dwell with me forever
it is morning in my heart;
i shall sing when it reach the other shore,
It is morning in my heart.

title: My Portion Forever

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: All, all to Jesus, I consecrate anew;
Only His glory henceforth will I pursue:

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Take, take the world, with all its gilded toys,
Take, take the world, I covet not its joys,
Mine is a wealth no moth nor rust destroys;

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: All, all to Jesus, my trusting heart can say:
Led by His mercy, I'm walking ev'ry day:

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Though He may try me, this blessed truth I know:
He will not leave me, His promise tells me so;

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: All, all to Jesus, I cheerfully resign:
I have the witness that He, my Lord, is mine;

title: Lower And Lower

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Lower and lower, dear Lord, at Thy feet,
Seeking Thy Spirit, Thy mercy so sweet;
Down in our need, blessed Master, we fall,
Lower and lower; be Thou all in all.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Lower and lower, down at Thy cross,
All the world’s treasure counting but dross;
Down at Thy feet, blessed Savior, we fall,
Lower, still lower, Christ all in all!

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Lower and lower, dear Savior, we pray,
Losing the self-life still more every day;
Weak and unworthy, we’re looking above:
Empty us wholly; then fill us with love.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Lower and lower; yet higher we rise
Lifted in Christ, freed from all the earth ties:
Humbly we follow the way of the cross.
Then, crowns of glory, and gain for all loss.

title: Let The Fire Fall

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: They were gathered in an upper chamber,
As commanded by the risen Lord,
And the promise of the Father
There they sought with one accord,
When the Holy Ghost from heaven descended
Like a rushing wind and tongues of fire:
So dear Lord, we seek Thy blessing,
Come with glory now our hearts inspire.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Let the fire fall, let the fire fall,
Let the fire from heaven fall;
Now in faith, dear Lord, we call;
Let the fire fall, let the fire fall,
From the glory of Thy presence

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: As Elijah we would raise the altar
For our testimony clear and true,
Ever flowing grace and full salvation,
For a ruined race Thy love has planned;
For Thy written Word we dare to stand.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: To as many as the Lord shall call,
To the Fathers and their children,
To Thy people, one and all;
So rejoicing in Thy Word unfailing,
We draw nigh in faith Thy power to know;
Come, O come Thou burning Spirit,
Set our hearts with heav'nly fire aglow.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: With a living coal from off Thy altar
Touch our lips to swell Thy wondrous praise,
To extol Thee, bless, adore Thee,
And our songs of worship raise;
Let the cloud of glory now descending,
Fill our hearts with holy ecstasy;
Come in all Thy glorious fulness,
Blessed Holy Spirit, have Thy way.

title: Redeemed

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Redeemed—how I love to proclaim it!
Redeemed by the blood of the Lamb;
His child, and forever, I am.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Redeemed by the blood of the Lamb;
His child, and forever, I am.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Redeemed and so happy in Jesus,
No language my rapture can tell;
I know that the light of His presence

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: I think of my blessed Redeemer,
I think of Him all the day long;
I sing, for I cannot be silent;
His love is the theme of my song.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: I know I shall see in His beauty
The King in whose way I delight;
And giveth me songs in the night.

title: Jesus Send More Labourers

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: For, Lord, we see the need
The land is ready for harvest

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Oh Lord, but start with me
Who will go for You, Lord?
Who will go for You, Lord?
Here I am, Lord Send me

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: That through us Your will be done

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: We are ready to serve You
To go this day, this hour

title: Oh To Be Like Thee

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Oh, to be like Thee, blessed Redeemer,
This is my constant longing and prayer;
Gladly I'll forfeit all of earth's treasures,
Jesus, Thy perfect likeness to wear.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Oh, to be like Thee, Oh! to be like Thee,
Blessed Redeemer, pure as Thou art;
Come in Thy sweetness, come in Thy fulness;
Stamp Thine own image deep on my heart.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: O, to be like Thee, full of compassion,
Helping the helpless, cheering the fainting,
Seeking the wand'ring sinner to find.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Oh, to be like Thee, lowly in spirit,
Holy and harmless, patient and brave;
Willing to suffer, others to save.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Oh, to be like Thee, Lord, I am coming,
Now to receive th' anointing divine,
All that I am and have I am bringing,
Lord, from this moment all shall be Thine.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Oh, to be like Thee, while I am pleading,
Pour out Thy Spirit, fill with Thy love,
Make me a temple meet for Thy dwelling,
Fit me for life and heaven above.

title: More Like The Master

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: More like the Master I would ever be,
More of His meekness, more humility;
More zeal to labor, more courage to be true,
More consecration for work He bids me do.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Take Thou my heart, I would be Thine alone;
Take Thou my heart and make it all Thine own.
Purge me from sin, O Lord, I now implore,
Wash me and keep me Thine forevermore.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: More like the Master is my daily prayer;
More strength to carry crosses I must bear;
More earnest effort to bring His kingdom in,
More of His Spirit, the wanderer to win.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: More like the Master I would live and grow;
More of His love to others I would show;
More self-denial, like His in Galilee,
More like the Master I long to ever be.

title: Gracious Spirit Dwell With Me

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: and with words that help and heal
would thy life in mine reveal;
and with actions bold and meek
would for Christ my Savior speak.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: choose and cherish all things good,
give to him who gave me thee!

title: Great shepherd of thy people hear
author: Christ Apostolic Church (CAC) Worldwide

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Great shepherd of thy people hear
As Thou hast giv'n a place for pray'r
So give us hearts to pray.

title: Our fainting hope to raise,
author: Christ Apostolic Church (CAC) Worldwide

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: And pour thy blessing from above

title: And love and concord dwell,
author: Christ Apostolic Church (CAC) Worldwide

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Here give the trouble conscience ease

title: The contrite heart bestow:
author: Christ Apostolic Church (CAC) Worldwide

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: And shine upon us from on high
That we in grace may grow.

title: In faith address our pray'rs,
author: Christ Apostolic Church (CAC) Worldwide

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: And in the presence of our Lord

title: Forth in Thy Name, O Lord I go,
author: Christ Apostolic Church (CAC) Worldwide

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Forth in Thy Name, O Lord I go,
Thee, only Thee, resolved to know
In all I think, or speak, or do.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: The task thy wisdom hath assigned
In all my works Thy presence find,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Preserve me from my calling's snare
And hide my simple heart above,
Above the thorns of choking care
The gilded baits of worldly love

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Thee may I set at my right hand,
Whose eyes my inmost substance see,
And labour on at Thy command,
And offer all my works to Thee.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Give me to bear Thy easy yoke,
And every moment watch and pray
And still to things eternal look,
And hasten to Thy glorious day.

stanzas.label: Verse 6
lines: Whate'er Thy bounteous grace hath giv'n,
And run my course with even joy,
And closely walk with Thee to heaven.
When will Thou come unto me: Ps. 101:2

stanzas.label: Verse 7
lines: Come to me, Lord, when first I wake
As the faint lights of morning break;
Bid purest thoughts within me rise,
Like crystal dew-drops to the skies.

stanzas.label: Verse 8
lines: Come to me in the sultry noon,
Or earth's low communing will soon
Of Thy dear Face, eclipse the light,
And change my fairest day to night

stanzas.label: Verse 9
lines: Come to me in the evening shade
And if my heart from Thee hath strayed,
Oh bring it back, and from afar
Smile on me like Thine ev'ning star

stanzas.label: Verse 10
lines: Come to me in the midnight hour,
When sleep withholds its balmy pow'r;
Let my lone spirit find her rest,
Like John, upon my Saviour's breast.

stanzas.label: Verse 11
lines: Come to me through life's varied way,
And when its pulses cease to play
Then, Saviour, bid me come to Thee
That where Thou art, Thy child  may be.

title: Christ, whose glory fills the skies,
author: Christ Apostolic Church (CAC) Worldwide

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Christ, whose glory fills the skies,
Christ, the true, the only Light
Triumph o'er the shades of night;
Day-spring from on high, be near,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Dark and cheerless is the morn
Till thy mercy's return I see,
Glad my eyes, and warm my heart

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Visit then this soul of mine;
Pierce the gloom of sin and grief;
Evening and morning and at noon will I pray. Ps. 55:17.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Come, let us kneel and pray;
Pray'r is the Christian pilgrim's staff
To walk with God all day.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Sweet is the shadow from the heat
When the sun smites by day.

stanzas.label: Verse 6
lines: At eve shut to the door
And finding there the house of God
At heav'n's gate close the day.

stanzas.label: Verse 7
lines: I sleep, but my heart, waketh, Lord,
With Thee to watch and pray.
He shall cover thee with His feathers. Ps. 91:4

stanzas.label: Verse 8
lines: The morning bright with rosy light
Has waked me from my sleep;
Father, I own Thy love alone

stanzas.label: Verse 9
lines: All through the day, I humbly pray,
Be Thou my guard and guide;
My sins forgive, and let me live,

stanzas.label: Verse 10
lines: Oh make Thy rest within my breast,
Make the like thee, then shall I be

title: Love divine, all loves excelling,
author: Christ Apostolic Church (CAC) Worldwide

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Joy of heav'n to earth come down;
Fix in us Thy humble dwelling

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Let us all thy grace receive:
Thee we would be always blessing,
Serve, Thee as Thy hosts above,
Pray, and praise Thee, without ceasing

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Pure and spotless let us be;
Let us see Thy great salvation,
Till in heav'n we take our place,
Till we cast our crowns before Thee,
Lost in wonder, love and praise.
Awake psaltery and harp, I myself will awake early. Ps. 108:2

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Awake, my soul, and with the sun
Thy daily stage of duty run;
Shake off dull sloth, and joyful rise

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Each present day thy last esteem;
Improve thy talent with due care;
For the great day thyself prepare.

stanzas.label: Verse 6
lines: Let all thy converse be sincere,
Thy conscience as the noontide clear;
Thing how all seeing God thy ways
And all thy secret thoughts surveys

stanzas.label: Verse 7
lines: By influence of the light Divine
Let thy own light to others shine;
In ardent love and cheerful praise.

stanzas.label: Verse 8
lines: Wake and lift up thyself, my heart,
And with the angles bear thy part,
Who all night long unwearied sing
High praise to the eternal King.

title: Jesus, Sun of righteousness,
author: Christ Apostolic Church (CAC) Worldwide

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Do Thou on our darkness shine,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: As on drooping herb and flow'r
Let Thy spirit's grace and pow'r

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: May Thy love with tender glow
Warm and cheer us forth to go,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Oh, our only Hope and Guide,
Keep us ever at Thy side

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Lead us all our days and years]
In Thy straight and narrow way;
Lead us through the vale of tears
To the land of perfect day,

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Hear my cry o God, attend unto my prayer. Ps 61:

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Move me, draw me win me

title: Once more the sun is beaming bright,
author: Christ Apostolic Church (CAC) Worldwide

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Once more the sun is beaming bright,
Once more to God we pray,
That His eternal light may guide
And cheer our soul this day.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: O may no sin our hands defile
Or cause our minds to rove,
Upon our lips be simple truth,
And in our hearts be love!.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Throughout the day, O Christ, in thee
di	To save our souls from Satan's wiles,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: So may our works, in Thee begun,

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: And lest the flesh, profane and proud,

stanzas.label: Verse 6
lines: To God the father God the son,

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: And Abraham drew near unto the Lord. Gen. 18:23

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Let me come close to Thee, Jesus,
Let me lean harder on Thee, Jesus

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Let me show forth Thy beauty, Jesus
Oh let my lips pour forth thy sweetness

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Yes, like a fountain precious Jesus,
Make me and let me be;
Keep me and use me daily, Jesus,

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: In all my heart and will, o Jesus,
Make me a loyal subject, Jesus,

stanzas.label: Verse 6
lines: Thirsting and hungering for thee, Jesus,
Longing for home in Zion's mountain

title: & Ref.
author: Christ Apostolic Church (CAC) Worldwide

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: And God said let there be light and there was light Gen. 1:3

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: There is sunshine in the valley,
There is sunshine on the hill.
Jesus brought it to this darken'd world below.
There is sunshine in the flowers,
There is blessed sunshine ev'rywhere I go.
Sunshine, sunshine of His love divine,
Sunshine, sunshine beams so brightly shine,
Sunshine, sunshine,  in this world below.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: There is sunshine on the meadow,
Where the birds are warbling note of joy and peace
There is sunshine on the mountain,
There is sunshine on the plain,
Let all nature now the happy chorus praise.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Tho' the world is full of sunshine
There are souls who live in darkness at the while,
They have never heard of Jesus,
Let us help and cheer them with a sunny smile

title: Through all the dangers of the night
author: Christ Apostolic Church (CAC) Worldwide

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Through all the dangers of the night
The Lord doth keep me safe,
And to bow down the knee.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Oh Lord we pray keep us today,
Only the ones whom thou doth keep

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Let all our thoughts and all our deeds,
So that our light may truly shine
And beam to all the world.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: O grant that we ne'er stray from Thee,
Until our eyes there shall behold

title: D.
author: Christ Apostolic Church (CAC) Worldwide

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: The love of God is shed abroad in our
hearts by the Holy Spirit who give unto us. Rom 5 :5

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Seek Thou this soul of mine,
And visit it with Thine own ardour glowing;
And kindle it, Thy holy flame bestowing.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: To dust and ashes, in its heat consuming;
And clothe me round, the while my path illuming

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: And lowliness become mine inner clothing;

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: With which the soul will long,
Shall for out pass the pow'r of human telling;
For none can guess is grace,

title: Father of all, Thy care we bless
author: Christ Apostolic Church (CAC) Worldwide

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Father of all, Thy care we bless
Which crowns our families with peace:
From Thee they spring; and by Thy hand
They are, and shall be still sustained.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: To God, most worthy to be praised,
Who, Lord of heav'n , yet deigns to come

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: To thee may each united house
Morning and night present its vows,
Our servants there, and rising race,
Be taught Thy precepts and Thy grace.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: So may each future age proclaim
The honours of Thy glorious name,

title: Mercy and judgement will I sing,
author: Christ Apostolic Church (CAC) Worldwide

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Mercy and judgement will I sing,
I sing, O Lord, to Thee;
O when wilt Thou descend and bring
Thy light and life to me?

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: A perfect way in wisdom trod,
A way, a heart, a house, O God,
I seek, where Thou wilt come

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: I seek the faithful and the just;
Be these the friends in whom I trust,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: From lies, from slander, and deceit,
May it be found a dwelling meet,

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: I will sing of the mercies of the Lord for ever. Ps. 89 : 1

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Day by day we magnify Thee,
When, as each new day is born,
Our knees at home, we bless Thee
For the mercies of the morn.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: When our hymns in school we raise,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Day by day we magnify Thee
In our hymns before we sleep:
Angels hear them, watching by us,
Christ's dear Iambs all night to keep.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Day by day we magnify Thee
Not in words of praise alone,
Show Thy glory in Thine own

stanzas.label: Verse 6
lines: Day by day we magnify Thee
When for Jesus' sake we try
Every wrong to bear with patience,

stanzas.label: Verse 7
lines: Day by day we magnify Thee
Till our days on earth shall cease,
Till we rest from these our labours,
Waiting for Thy day in peace.

title: Glory to Thee, my God, this night,
author: Christ Apostolic Church (CAC) Worldwide

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Glory to Thee, my God, this night,
For all the blessings of the light:
Keep me, O keep me, king of kings,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Forgive me, Lord, for Thy dear son,
The ill that' I this day have done:
That with the world, myself, and Thee,
I, ere I sleep, at peace may be.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: O may my soul on Thee repose,
And may sweet sleep mine eyelids Close:,
Sleep that may more vigorous make
To serve my God when I awake.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: If in the night I sleepless lie,
My soul with heav'nly thoughts supply:
Let no ill dreams disturb my rest,
No pow'rs of darkness me molest.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Praise God, from whom all blessing flow
Praise Him, all creatures here below;
Praise Him above, ye heav'nly host;
Praise Father, Son, and Holy Ghost.

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Let my prayer be set forth before Thee as Evening sacrifice Ps. 141:2

stanzas.label: Verse 7
lines: Thus would I live: yet now
In all His pow;r and love

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: He who keepeth thee will not slumber Ps. 121: 3

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Thy love has spared our lives today
Though we lay-down, spent and worn,
Guard us in the stillness of night,
Us no pow'rs of darkness harm;
It is sweet to trust in Thee.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Pilgrims in this world and strangers
Dwelling in the midst of foes;
Keep us and dear ones from danger,
On thy wings in comfort sleep;
And when life's distress is over,
May our souls repose in Thee.

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Abide with us, for it is towards evening Luk. 24:29

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Abide with me fast falls the eventide;
The darkness deepens, Lord, with me abide!
When other helpers fair, and comforts flee,
Help of the helpless, O abide with me.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Swift to its close ebbs out life's little day,
Earth's joys grow dim, its glories pass away
Change and decay in all around I see
O Thou who changest not, abide With!

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Come not in terrors, as the King of Kings
But kind and good, with healing in Thy wings;
Tears for all woes, a heart for every plea.
Come Friend of sinners, thus abide with me.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: I need Thy presence every passing hours;
What but Thy grace can foil the tempter's pow'r?
Who like Thyself my guide and stay can be?
Though cloud and sunshine, O abide with me.

stanzas.label: Verse 6
lines: I fear no foe, with Thee at hand to bless;
Ills have no weight, and tears no bitterness
Where is death's sting? Where, grave, thy victory?
I triumph still, if Thou abide with me.

stanzas.label: Verse 7
lines: Hold Thou Thy Cross before my closing eyes;
Shine through the gloom, and point me to the skies;
Heav'n's morning breaks, and earth's vain shadows flee

lines: We feebly struggle; they in glory shine!
Yet all are one in Thee, for all are Thine. Alleluia!

Steals on the ear the distant triumph song,
And hearts are brave again, and arms are strong. Alleluia!

Sweet is the calm of paradise the blest Alleluia!

The king of Glory passes on His way. Alleluia!

And from my smitten heart with tears
The wonder of His glorious love,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: I take the Cross of Jesus
I ask no other sunshine than
Content to let the world go by,
To know no gain nor loss:
My sinful self my only shame,

title: Blessed be God, our God!
author: Horatius Bonar (1845)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Who gave for us His well-beloved Son,
The gift of gifts, all other gifts in one;

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Who freely gave this mighty gift, unbought,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: 'Tis this that silences each rising fear,
'Tis this that bids the hard thought disappear;

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Since Christ has died, and risen, and gone above
For us to plead at the right hand of Love;

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Who shall recall His pardon or His grace?
Or who the broken chain of guilt replace?

stanzas.label: Verse 6
lines: For us in might came forth the Mighty One,
For us He fought the fight, the triumph won;

title: Blest be the dear uniting love
author: Charles Wesley (1745)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Blest be the dear uniting love
That will not let us part;
Our bodies may far off remove,
But we are joined in heart.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Joined in one Spirit to our Head,
We wait His will to know,
That we in all His steps may tread,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: O may we ever walk in Him,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: To Him still closer let us cleave,

title: Behold, what love, what boundless love
author: Robert Boswell

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Behold, what love, what boundless love
On sinners lost, that we should be
Now called the sons of God.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: No longer far from Him, but now
Near to God's heart we lie.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: What we in glory soon shall be
But when our precious Lord we see.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: With such a blessed hope in view
More like our risen, glorious Lord.
Whose face we soon shall see.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Behold . . . what manner of love . . . what
manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon
us, that we . . . . that we should be called . . .
should be called the sons of God.

title: Be gone, unbelief! my Saviour is near.
author: John Newton (1779)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Be gone, unbelief! my Saviour is near.
And for my relief will surely appear;
By prayer let me wrestle, and He will perform;
With Christ in the vessel, I smile at the storm.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Though dark be my way, since He is my guide,
'Tis mine to obey, 'tis His to provide:
Though cisterns be broken and creatures all fail,
The word He hath spoken will surely prevail.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: His love in time past forbids me to think
He'll leave me at last in trouble to sink:
Each sweet Ebenezer I have in review
Confirms His good pleasure to help me quite through.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Why should I complain of want or distress,
Temptation or pain? He told me no less:
The heirs of salvation, I know from His Word,
Through much tribulation must follow their Lord.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: How bitter that cup no heart can conceive,
Which Jesus drank up that sinners might live!
His way was much rougher and darker than mine:
Did Jesus thus suffer, and shall I repine?

stanzas.label: Verse 6
lines: Since all that I meet shall work for my good.
The bitter is sweet, the med'cine is food;
Though painful at present, 'twill cease before long,
And then, oh, how pleasant the conqueror's song!

title: Blessed hope that in Jesus is given
author: Daniel Webster Whittle (1877)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Blessed hope that in Jesus is given
In our sorrow to cheer and sustain,
That soon with our Saviour in heaven
We shall meet with our loved ones again.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Blessed hope in the Word God has spoken,
All our peace by that Word we obtain;
And as sure as God's Word was ne'er broken
We shall meet with our loved ones again.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Blessed hope! how it shines in our sorrow
Like the star over Bethlehem's plain,
That it may be, with Him, ere the morrow
We shall meet with our loved ones again.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Blessed hope! the bright star of the morning
That shall herald His coming to reign;
O the glory that waits its fair dawning
When we meet with our loved ones again.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: We shall meet with our loved ones again.

title: Bride of the Lamb, there is for thee
author: Boethia Thompson

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Bride of the Lamb, there is for thee
Where Jesus is thy heart should be,
Thy home at His dear feet.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: When Satan tracks thy lonely way.
In Jesus' presence watch and pray,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Since thou has much to learn, e'en though
In grace and knowledge seek to grow

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: With Christ the cross is sweet;
The little while will soon be gone,

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Bride of the Lamb, forget the past,
'Tis thine to share His throne, and cast

title: Behold! Behold the Lamb of God
author: Joseph Hoskins (BHB Companion) / Richard Jukes (Primitive Methodist Magazine)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Behold! Behold the Lamb of God
For us He shed His precious blood
Draw near and see the Saviour die

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Behold His bleeding hands and side
The sun withholds its rays of light,
The heav'ns are clothed in shades of night,
While Jesus wins the glorious fight

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: By faith we see Him lifted up
He drinks for us the bitter cup
The rocks do rend, the mountains quake.
While Jesus suffers for our sake

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: And now the mighty deed is done
The battle fought, the vict'ry won
To heav'n He turns His languid eyes,
Then bows His sacred head and dies

title: Bright with all His crowns of glory
author: Sir Edward Denny

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Bright with all His crowns of glory,
Once for sinners marr'd and gory,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Lo! they fill the people air,
And His throne of glory share.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: King of kings! let earth adore Him,
Fall, ye nations, fall before Him,
Be to Him, and Him alone.

title: Christ's grave is vacant now
author: W. Noel Tomkins

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: His Cross asserts God's right to bless

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: And thence the child of faith
The soul that sins shall die!

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Learns how that God in love
Gave Christ the sins to bear
Of all who own His lordship now,
That they His place might share;

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: As He is so am I,
Pure, holy, love as Christ Himself;

stanzas.label: Verse 6
lines: Prove Jesus bears one spot of sin;

stanzas.label: Verse 7
lines: Nay! for He purged my guilt
And such its virtue not a stain
E'er meets the eye of God.

title: Christ has done the mighty work;
author: Horatius Bonar (1845)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Christ has done the mighty work;
Nothing left for us to do
But to enter on His toil,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: His the pardon, ours the sin,
Great the sin, the pardon great;
His the good, and ours the ill;
His the love, and ours the hate.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: His the labour, ours the rest;
His the death, and ours the life;

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: He has sowed the precious seed,
Ours it is to reap the field,
Make the harvest joy our own.

title: Come, all ye saints of God!
author: James Boden

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, all ye saints of God!
Tell what His love has done;

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: From heart and voice to sing,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: There, too, shall we be found,

title: Christians, go and tell of Jesus
author: Edward Payson Hammond

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Christians, go and tell of Jesus,
How He died to save our souls;
How that He, from sin might free us,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Tell the guilty of their danger
While they wander far from God;
While they live to Christ a stranger,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Tell them of the joys of heaven,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Tell them how He hath ascended
To prepare a home on high,
Where all sorrows shall be ended,
Where the saved shall never die.

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Yes, we'll go and tell of Jesus,
The pure and holy, meek and lowly Jesus;
Yes, we'll go and tell of Jesus,
Who died our souls to save.

title: Cling to the Mighty One
author: Henry Bennett

title: Christ the Lord is risen on high!
author: Anonymous

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Christ the Lord is risen on high!
Sing, ye heavens, and earth reply;
He endured the Cross, the grave,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Fought the fight, the battle won!

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Vain the stone, the watch, the seal,
Christ has burst the gates of hell;

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Christ our Lord is risen indeed,
Christ is now the Church's Head;
Loud the song of triumph raise,

title: Come, let us join our cheerful songs
author: Isaac Watts (1707)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, let us join our cheerful songs
Had we ten thousand, thousand tongues,
Our theme of joy's but one.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Worthy the Lamb enthroned on high
Worthy the Lamb who died, we cry,
For He was slain for us.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: And blessings more than we can give

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Soon shall the saints, exalted high,
And all that dwell beneath the sky

title: Come, let us all unite to sing
author: Howard Kingbury (?)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, let us all unite to sing,
Let heaven and earth their praises bring;
Let every soul from sin awake,
Each in his heart sweet music make,
And sing with us, for Jesus' sake,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: O tell to earth's remotest bound,
In Christ we have redemption found:
His blood has washed our sins away,
His Spirit turned our night to day;
And now we can rejoice to say,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: How happy is our portion here!
He is our sun and shield by day,
Our help, our hope, our strength, and stay,
He will be with us all the way:

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: In glory we shall sing again,
Yes, this shall be our lofty strain,
In concert with the heavenly throng,
This shall be still our sweetest song,

title: Come, let us sing the matchless worth
author: Samuel Medley

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, let us sing the matchless worth,
And sweetly sound the glories forth
To God and Christ our praises bring;
The song, with which the heavens ring,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: How rich the precious blood He spilt,
Our ransom from the dreadful guilt

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Great are the offices He bears,
In songs of sweet untiring praise,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: And soon the happy day shall come
When we shall reach our destined home
And see Him face to face;
Then with our Saviour, Master, Friend,

title: Come, ye that know the Saviour's above
author: George Burder

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, ye that know the Saviour's name,
Let every heart and voice unite

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: His Word this precious truth reveals,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: His patience, bearing much and long
With those who from Him rove,
His kindness, while He leads them home,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: The work begun is carried on
And every step, from first to last,

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: O may we all, while here below,
Till nobler songs, in brighter worlds

title: Crowned with thorns upon the tree
author: H. Grattan Guinness

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Crowned with thorns upon the tree,
Of the wrath and curse of God.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: On thy pale and suff'ring brow,
On Thy grief and sore amaze,
Saviour, I would fix my gaze!

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: On Thy pierced and bleeding breast
Thou dost bid the weary rest;
Rest there from the world's false ways,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: From the load of guilt and grief;
Rest in perfect peace with God.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Thou art precious in mine eyes;
Thou alone my rest shall be,

title: Come, Thou Fount of every blessing
author: Robert Robinson (1758)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, Thou Fount of every blessing,
Tune my heart to sing Thy grace;
Call for songs of loudest praise.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Jesus sought me when a stranger
Wandering from the fold of God;
He, to save my soul from danger,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: O to grace how great a debtor
Let that grace, Lord, like a fetter,
Bind my wandering heart to Thee.

title: Crowns of glory ever bright
author: Thomas Kelly

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Crowns of glory are His right,
His, who liveth, and was dead.
Jesus fought and won the day,
Such a day was never fought;
Well His people now may say,
See what God, our God, has wrought.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: He subdued the powers of hell;
In the fight He stood alone;
All His foes before Him fell,
They have fall'n to rise no more;

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: His the fight, the arduous toil,
His the honours of the day,
His the glory and the spoil,
Fill the world with His renown;

title: Done is the work that saves
author: Horatius Bonar (1845)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Done is the work that saves,
The love that blesses us below
Is flowing freely to us now.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: The veil is rent in twain,
Why stand we then without, in fear?
The blood of Christ invites us near.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Is clear, and free, and bright
With love, and peace, and day.
Into the holiest now we come,
Our present and our endless home.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Has made and keeps us clean;
With boldness let us now draw near;
That blood has banished every fear.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Then to the Lamb once slain
Who loved us, cleansed us by His blood,
And made us kings and priests to God.

title: Father! we, Thy children, bless Thee
author: Samuel Prideaux Tregelles

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Father! we, Thy children, bless Thee
For Thy love on us bestowed:
As our Father we address Thee,
Called to be the sons of God.
Wondrous was Thy love in giving
Jesus for our sins to die;
Wondrous was His grace in leaving,
For our sakes, His home on high.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Now the sprinkled blood has freed us
On we go toward our rest;
Through the desert Thou dost lead us,
By Thy truth and Spirit guiding,
Earnest He of joys to come,
Thou dost lead Thy children home.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Shall we of the way be weary
When we see our Master's face?
In this hope our souls rejoice;
Soon shall hear His welcome voice.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Father, O how rich the blessing
Then Thy saints, their rest possessing,
O'er the earth with Him shall reign.
Shall on earth, the curse removed,
Be the people of the Lord.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Robes made white in Jesus' blood,
Stand around the throne of God.
Shall in triumph bless Thy name;
To our God, and to the Lamb.

title: Faint not, Christian! though the road
author: James H. Evans

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Faint not, Christian! though the road
Christ, thy Guide, will bring thee through.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Faint not, Christian! though in rage

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Faint not, Christian! though the world
Hold the Cross of Jesus fast,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: There's a heart so prone to sin;
Christ, thy Lord, is over all,
He'll not suffer thee to fall.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Faint not, Christian! though thy God
Smite thee with the chast'ning rod;
Smite He must with Father's care,
That He may His love declare.

stanzas.label: Verse 6
lines: Faint not, Christian! Christ is near;
Then shall end thy toil and strife,
Death be swallowed up of life.

title: For ever with the Lord!
author: James Montgomery

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Life from the dead is in that word,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Home of my soul, how near
At times to Faith's foreseeing eye

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: To reach the land I love,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: The promise of that faithful word

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: How shall I love that word,
And oft repeat before the throne

stanzas.label: Chorus
lines: Yet nightly pitch my moving tent

title: For the bread and for the wine
author: Horatius Bonar (1845)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: For the bread and for the wine,
For the pledge that seals Him mine,
For the words of love divine,
We give Thee thanks, O Lord.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Yet to faith the solemn sign
We give Thee thanks, O Lord.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: For the words that turn our eye
Bidding us in faith draw nigh,
We give Thee thanks, O Lord.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: For the words that fragrance breathe,
Words that His own peace bequeath,
We give Thee thanks, O Lord.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: For the words that tell of home,
Do ye this, until I come!
We give Thee thanks, O Lord.

stanzas.label: Verse 6
lines: Till He come we take the bread,
Type of Him on whom we feed,
Him who liveth and was dead!
We give Thee thanks, O Lord.

stanzas.label: Verse 7
lines: Till He come we take the cup;
As we at His table sup
Eye and heart are lifted up!
We give Thee thanks, O Lord.

stanzas.label: Verse 8
lines: For that day to man unknown,
For the glory and the throne,
We give Thee thanks, O Lord.

title: From every stormy wind that blows
author: Hugh Stowell (1828)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: From every stormy wind that blows,
From every swelling tide of woes,
There is a calm, a safe retreat;

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: There is a place where Jesus sheds
The oil of gladness on our heads,
A place than all beside more sweet;

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: There is a spot where spirits blend,
Where friend holds fellowship with friend;
Though sundered far, by faith we meet

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Ah! Whither could we flee for aid,
Or how the hosts of hell defeat,

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: There, there on eagle-wing we soar,
And time and sense appear no more;
There heav'nly joys our spirits greet,

title: From whence this fear and unbelief
author: Augustus Montague Toplady

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: From whence this fear and unbelief,
If God, my Father, put to grief
Can He, the righteous Judge of men,
Condemn me for that debt of sin
Which, Lord, was charged to Thee?

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: And to the utmost farthing paid
How, then, can wrath on me take place,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: If Thou hast my discharge procured,
And freely in my place endured
Payment God will not twice demand,
First at my bleeding Surety's hand,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Turn then, my soul, unto thy rest;
The merits of thy great High Priest
Nor fear thy banishment from God,

title: Glory, glory everlasting
author: Thomas Kelly

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Be to Him who bore the Cross,
Who redeemed our souls by tasting
Death, the death deserved by us!

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: While we hear the wondrous story
Of the Saviour's Cross and shame,
Be to God and to the Lamb!
Give ye glory to His name.

title: God moves in a mysterious way
author: William Cowper (1774)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: God moves in a mysterious way
He plants His footsteps in the sea,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: He treasures up His bright designs,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Ye fearful saints fresh courage take;
The clouds ye so much dread
Are big with mercy, and shall break

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Judge not the Lord by feeble sense,
But trust Him for His grace;

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: The bud may have a bitter taste,
But sweet will be the flower.

stanzas.label: Verse 6
lines: Blind unbelief is sure to err
And scan His work in vain;
And He will make it plain.

title: Glory unto Jesus be!
author: Archibald Rutherford

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Thou from wrath didst set us free;
All our guilt on Thee was laid,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: All the blessed work is done;
God's well pleased in His Son,
For He raised Thee from the dead,
Set Thee over all as Head.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: All should sing Thy work and worth,
All above, and all on earth;
We shall sit around the throne,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Knowing this, we cease to mourn,
For Thy saints with Thee shall reign;

title: Grace! 'tis a charming sound
author: Philip Doddridge & Augustus Montague Toplady (1755)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Heaven with the echo shall resound,
And all the earth shall hear.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: And new supplies each hour I meet,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: 'Twas grace that gave me to the Lamb

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Grace taught my soul to pray,
'Tis grace has kept me to this day,
And will not let me go.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: May all my powers to Thee aspire,
And all my days be Thine.

stanzas.label: Verse 6
lines: Grace all the work shall crown
It lays in heaven the topmost stone,

title: Glory to God on high!
author: Thomas Kelly

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Love that no tongue can teach,
Love that no thought can reach,
Death ne'er can stop its course,

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Blest in this love we sing,

title: God's almighty arms are round me
author: James McGranahan & Joseph Denham Smith

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: God's almighty arms are round me,
Judgment scenes need not confound me,
Jesus came Himself and sought me;
Sold to death, He found and bought me;
Then my blessed freedom taught me

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: While I hear life's surging billows,
Why suspend my harp on willows?
I may sing with Christ beside me,
Though a thousand ills betide me,
Safely He hath sworn to guide me,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: All His strokes but make Him dearer,
Bless I then the hand that smiteth

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Death and hell cannot appall me,
Safe in Christ whate'er befall me,
Calmly wait I, till He call me,

title: Great God of wonders! All Thy ways
author: Samuel Davies (1769)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Great God of wonders! All Thy ways
But the bright glories of Thy grace
Who is a pardoning God like Thee?
Or who has grace so rich and free?

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Such guilty, daring worms to spare!
And in this honour none shall share:
Who is a pardoning God like Thee?
Or who has grace so rich and free?

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Pardon, for sins of deepest dye!
Pardon, that brings the rebel nigh!
Who is a pardoning God like Thee?
Or who has grace so rich and free?

title: Great Shepherd of Thy chosen flock
author: John Newton (1779)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Great Shepherd of Thy chosen flock,
Thy people's shield, Their shadowing rock,
Once more we meet to hear Thy voice,
Once more before Thee to rejoice.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Now may Thy Spirit, by the Word,
Refresh each wearied heart, O Lord,
Wearied of earth's vain strife and woe,
And longing more Thyself to know.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Thine is the heart our griefs to feel,
And Thine the love each wound to heal;
Home Thou are gone for us to care,
Returning soon to take us there.

title: Guide us, O Thou great Jehovah
author: William Williams Pantycelyn tr/ad by Peter Williams (1745)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Guide us, O Thou great Jehovah,
We are weak, but Thou art mighty;
Hold us by Thy Powerful hand:

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Be Thou still our strength and shield.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: While we tread this vale of sorrow
May we in Thy love abide;
Keep us, O our gracious Saviour!

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Saviour, come! We long to see Thee,
Long to dwell with Thee above;
And to know, in full communion,
All the sweetness of Thy love:

title: Hail, Thou once despised Jesus!
author: John Bakewell & Martin Madan (1757)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Thou didst suffer to release us,
Bearer of our sin and shame!
Life and glory through Thy name.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: All our sins on Thee were laid;
All who trust Thee are forgiven
Through the virtue of Thy blood;
Rent in Thee the veil of heaven,
Grace shines forth to man from God.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Where for us Thou dost abide;
We, by faith, do now adore Thee,
There, for us Thou now art pleading,
While Thou dost our place prepare;

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Thou shalt then from all receive;
All that earth or heaven can give:
In that day Thy saints will meet Thee,
Joyful hearts will ever greet Thee,
Source of joy to all the throng.

title: Happy they who trust in Jesus!
author: Thomas Kelly

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Happy they who trust in Jesus!
Sweet their portion is, and sure;
When the foe on others seizes,
He will keep His own secure:

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Since His love and mercy found us
We are precious in His sight;
Thousands now may fall around us,
Thousands more be put to flight;
Keeps us safe by day and night.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Though we cannot boast of numbers,
In His strength secure we are:

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: As the bird, beneath her feathers,
Guards the objects of her care,
So the Lord His children gathers,
Spreads His wings and hides them there:
All their foes they boldly dare.

title: Hark! my soul, it is the Lord;
author: William Cowper (1768)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Hark! my soul, it is the Lord;
Jesus speaks, and speaks to thee:
Say, poor sinner, lov'st thou Me?

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: And when wounded healed thy wound;
Sought thee wand'ring, set thee right,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Cease towards the child she bare?

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Free and faithful, strong as death.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Thou shalt see My glory soon
When the work of grace is done;
Partner of My throne shalt be:
Say, poor sinner, lov'st thou Me?

stanzas.label: Verse 6
lines: Lord, it is my chief complaint
That my love is cold and faint;
Yet I love Thee, and adore;
O for grace to love Thee more.

title: Hark! 'tis the watchman's cry
author: Anonymous & The Revival (1859)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Sleep is for sons of night;
Ye are children of the light,

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Be ye as men that wait
E'en though the hour seem late;

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: Weakness needs the strong One near,

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Soon to lead the eternal songs,

title: Hark! ten thousand voices crying
author: John Nelson Darby (1837)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Lamb of God! with one accord;
Wake at once the echoing chord.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Praise the Lamb, the chorus waking,
Loud and far, each tongue partaking,

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: All the mind in heaven is one.

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Crowned with light and joy unfading,
Hail Him as the great I AM.

title: Have ye counted the cost?
author: Jane Eliza Leeson

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Are ye fixed in heart for your Master's sake
Can ye bear the scoff of the worldly-wise,
As ye pass by pleasure's bower,
To watch with your Lord on the mountain-top

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Ye may drink of His cup,
Ye may drink of His cup,
Ye shall not fail, if ye tread in His steps
But count ye the cost; O count ye the cost!
And know ye the strength that alone can stand
In the conflict ye have dared.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: In the power of His might,
In the power of His might,
Who was made through weakness strong,
Ye shall overcome in the fearful fight
By the blood of the Lamb, by the blood of the Lamb,
Not loving your lives unto death for Him,
Ye shall triumph with your Lord.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: It will cost you a pang to hold!
But 'twill float in triumph the field above
Though your heart's blood stain its fold.
Ye may count the cost, ye may count the cost
But the riches of Christ ye cannot count;

title: Head of the Church triumphant
author: Charles Wesley (1745)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Would sing of Thee in glory.
We lift our hearts and voices

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Shall keep us Thine for ever.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: The world, with sin and Satan,

title: He comes! Emmanuel comes!
author: James George Deck (1841)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Who bowed His head and died;
Who hath redeemed us by His blood;

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Who bears us on His breast,
O let this hope dispel each fear,
Our great High Priest will soon appear.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Of love divine, His flock He'll bring.

stanzas.label: Verse 4
lines: He comes! the Heir of all,
But O His love, what tongue can tell?

stanzas.label: Verse 5
lines: Naught else can satisfy her heart
But to be with Thee where Thou art.

title: Heirs of salvation, chosen of God!
author: Hannah Kilham Burlingham

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: Heirs of salvation, chosen of God!
Even in Egypt feed we on the Lamb,
Keeping the statutes of God, the I AM.
Where the feast is spread, 'tis bright;
'Tis Jesus, 'tis Jesus, our Saviour from above.
'Tis Jesus, 'tis Jesus, 'tis Jesus whom we love.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: Pilgrims and strangers, captives no more;
Wilderness rangers, sing we on the shore.
God in His power parted hath the sea,
Foes have all perished, His people are free.
Now the homeward way we tread.
'Tis Jesus, 'tis Jesus, our Shepherd here below,
'Tis Jesus, 'tis Jesus, 'tis Jesus whom we know.

stanzas.label: Verse 3
lines: Cares of the desert no longer in mind.
Canaan's corn our strength and stay,
'Tis Jesus, 'tis Jesus, the Christ of God alone,
'Tis Jesus, 'tis Jesus, 'tis Jesus whom we own.

title: He leadeth me, O blessed thought!
author: Joseph Henry Gilmore (1862)

stanzas.label: Verse 1
lines: He leadeth me, O blessed thought!
O words with heavenly comfort fraught!
Whate'er I do, where'er I be,
Still 'tis God's hand that leadeth me.

stanzas.label: Verse 2
lines: By waters still, o'er troubled sea,
